verdict.rationale: Ente's own llms.txt says its apps and server are open source, and a community commenter thanks the team for releasing Auth as open source. The docs link to the public github.com/ente/ente monorepo and describe self-hosting, which supports that the source is readable. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in evidence, there is no direct first-party link to the Auth app's source tree or license file, and no hands-on confirmation of the repository's license terms.
